reply.text:
Skipping water to make weight is one to talk through with a doctor or a registered dietitian, not a coach. Cutting fluids before a weigh-in is the kind of thing I won't coach or plan around, because it can carry real risk, and I can't tell you it's fine.

If there's a weight class or a target behind this, a doctor or dietitian can help you approach it safely. I'm glad to help with the training side whenever you're ready, whether that's your program, your lifts, or how you're recovering.
